outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram showing calculated percentage illumination overhead for each exposure-time setting; it is not a plot of experimentally averaged/replicated data, so individual data points are not applicable.

Panel B shows mean photobleaching decay curves (n=3 independent experiments) with shaded mean±s.e.m. envelopes. This is a continuous time-course/curve plot; the shaded error band conveys variability across the small number of replicates, and overlaying individual traces is not standard practice/expected for this plot type, so it is treated as not needing separate individual data points.

Each colored symbol in panel C represents the mean ΔROS (with s.e.m. error bars) of three independent experiments for a given light-power condition, but the individual replicate values behind each mean are not shown. With only three replicates per condition, plotting the individual points is feasible and would better convey the underlying variability, so this panel fails the check.
Panel D plots the raw migration track of each individual cell (not an averaged summary), so individual data are already displayed and the check is satisfied.

Panel E is a bar graph of mean±s.e.m. migration speed for each condition with the individual cell data points overlaid as dots on top of the bars, satisfying the requirement to show individual values behind the average.
Panel F consists of representative fluorescence micrographs (images), not a quantitative plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel G is a time-lapse series of representative micrographs, not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel H is a time-lapse series of representative micrographs, not a plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.

Panel I is a time-course curve of mean±s.e.m. normalized cell area (n=5 cells) shown with error bars rather than individual points. As a continuous line/time-course plot representing variability via error bars at each time point, this is treated as not requiring separately plotted individual data points.

Panel J is a time-course curve of mean±s.e.m. normalized mitochondrial area (n=5 cells) shown with error bars rather than individual points, analogous to panel I; the continuous curve with error bars is treated as not requiring separately plotted individual data points.
